## Details

<a id="move_return_flags"></a>
### [`move_return_flags`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L9) `$115D-$1175`

*data*

Move table, one byte per move $00-$18. Bit 7 keeps the input of the move; nonzero lets the move return to the stance by itself.

- **Read by:** [`move_update_state`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_update_state), [`move_anim_end`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_anim_end)

<a id="move_attack_flags"></a>
### [`move_attack_flags`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L15) `$1176-$118E`

*data*

Move table: 1 for the 11 attack moves ($06, $07, $0a-$11, $18).

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](../ai/ai_opponent.md#ai_update), [`fighter_update`](../fighter/fighter_input.md#fighter_update), [`move_fix_input`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_fix_input), [`move_start_anim`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_start_anim), [`hit_check`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_check)

<a id="move_counter_moves"></a>
### [`move_counter_moves`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L21) `$118F-$11A7`

*data*

Move table: the block or dodge that answers each attack move, 0 for none.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](../ai/ai_opponent.md#ai_update), [`move_fix_input`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_fix_input)

<a id="move_reach_types"></a>
### [`move_reach_types`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L27) `$11A8-$11BC`

*data*

Move table of 21 bytes: reach type of the attack. Moves $15-$18 read the first 4 bytes of the next table, which are 0.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test), [`hit_range_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_range_test)

<a id="move_full_reach"></a>
### [`move_full_reach`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L32) `$11BD-$11D5`

*data*

Move table: reach value for a full point of the attack.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test)

<a id="move_half_reach"></a>
### [`move_half_reach`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L38) `$11D6-$11EE`
